notes: Approximate campus sizes for the large university campuses, whose point data all carried the same 120 m circle. The radius is of a circle with about the campus area (本郷 about 56 ha, long north to south, so a slightly wide circle; 駒場 about 30 ha ...); the figures are rough game assumptions from general knowledge, not surveyed or official values. Small city campuses of 4 to 6 ha fit the default circle and are left alone. A record applies to the university point of that name within 60 m of xy.
